content.text: {"answer": "platform", "evidence": "A change freeze is declared before a release train and lifted after it. While one is in effect, every service in the platform tier pages outside working hours regardless of its own entry, because a freeze means nobody is standing by to pick up a ticket in the morning. Services in other tiers keep the paging rule written in their own entry. A freeze changes nothing about escalation codes, owning teams or acknowledgement windows."}
